The target is the center of the 4×3 purple glass window on the front (south-facing) wall of the stone brick building at spawn-relative [8, 2, 3]. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable observation distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the window.

scene_description: A small stone brick building with prominent purple stained glass pane windows on the front (south-facing) wall and side (east-facing) wall. The building is set on a flat grass area approximately 6-11 blocks east and 3-9 blocks south of spawn. A decorative oak tree is placed to the northwest of spawn, and a lantern and cobblestone wall post provide additional landmarks. The player must navigate to the building and look at the purple stained glass panes to complete the task.
task_text: Find the purple stained glass panes in the stone brick building nearby.
design_notes: Building is at ~6-11 X, ~3-9 Z relative to spawn. Front wall (Z=3) has a 4×3 purple glass window (12 panes). East wall (X=11) has 2×2 purple glass windows (4 panes). Total: 16 purple stained glass panes. Door opening is at X=6, Z=5 (west wall). Player spawns at origin facing the building which is ~6 blocks away diagonally. Oak tree at ~-3, ~-2 provides visual variety without blocking the view. Lantern and cobblestone wall serve as path markers.
